rationale: The pain is real and reproducible — Salesforce metadata deployments that silently succeed but fail at runtime are a documented, costly problem. However, the evidence base is too thin to meet the pass threshold: only a single source post is available, there are no 5 distinct pain quotes from separate users, and no direct willingness-to-pay signal specific to this problem (general Salesforce tooling spend from Gearset/Copado is adjacent but not dispositive). The opportunity should be re-queued after Market Radar locates at least four more corroborating threads.
